name: The Heal Build - MINHA CÓPIA
author: HanaTomic

notes: Research @technology_templar/safepassage.webp@ and set a pilgrim destination @resource/sacred_sites.webp@
When pilgrims start reaching @resource/sacred_sites.webp@ then pull a few @unit_worker/villager.webp@ off @resource/resource_gold.webp@
Macro towards your 2nd unit. I like to add @unit_infantry/archer-2.webp@ but you will have to adapt to what your opponent is doing.
We should have about 15 @unit_templar/hospitaller_knight_age_2.webp@ and 2nd unit coming in.
Add a @building_technology/blacksmith.webp@ for @technology_military/iron-undermesh.webp@. Do also get your @technology_military/bloomery.webp@ & @technology_military/fitted-leatherwork.webp@
Keep making units and go for resource denial, ram push or castle timing.

description:
Use the Hospitaller age-up for a strong healing frontline. Hospitallers also receive tremendous hp increase in castle and imperial, and thus scale well making this build a good castle build as well.

We age up to feudal at 4:20 with 4 farms, to have more villagers gathering resources instead of the fastest possible age-up.
